build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --prefer-dist --no-interaction && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: touch .env && [ -n "$APP_KEY" ] || php artisan key:generate --force --no-interaction 2>/dev/null || true ; chmod -R 775 storage bootstrap/cache public 2>/dev/null || true ; php artisan optimize:clear ; php artisan migrate --force --no-interaction ; php artisan db:seed --force --no-interaction && touch storage/installed ; rm -rf public/storage ; php artisan storage:link --force ; php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
